email_subject: Application - Digital Content & Social Media Manager
email_body:
Dear Delvaux Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Digital Content & Social Media Manager position at Delvaux, as advertised. My background as a Digital Marketer with a strong focus on content, web optimization, and analytics aligns well with the innovative and strategic demands of this role.

In my previous positions, I have gained hands-on experience in developing and managing compelling digital content, optimizing online presence, and integrating social media strategies into broader digital campaigns. I am adept at leveraging tools like Canva for visual content, managing complex CMS platforms, and utilizing analytics to track performance and inform continuous improvement. My technical understanding also allows for a unique approach to digital content delivery.

I am eager to contribute my skills in content strategy, visual direction, and digital engagement to elevate Delvaux's brand across social platforms. My CV provides further detail on my qualifications, including my fluency in English.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Delvaux Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Digital Content & Social Media Manager position, having been drawn to Delvaux's commitment to elevating brand presence through a blend of artistic vision and strategic digital execution. My background as a Digital Marketer, focused on content creation, web optimization, and analytics, positions me to make a significant impact in this role.

My experience includes leading SEO blog and content writing, alongside comprehensive CMS content management, where I consistently ensured that digital narratives were not only engaging but also visually coherent and on-brand. For instance, at Episto, I managed the publishing and updating of pages and blog posts, maintaining consistent layouts across hundreds of member profiles. I also leveraged Canva for creating visual elements, contributing to a cohesive digital presence that mirrors Delvaux’s emphasis on captivating visual content and a strong brand aesthetic. My work at Knowledge Experts further involved designing and building client websites, including social media integration, demonstrating my understanding of how a brand’s online identity translates across platforms.

Beyond content creation, my analytical and strategic approach is well-developed. I have a proven track record of developing keyword-targeted content strategies to grow organic traffic, and I regularly monitor performance using advanced analytics tools like Google Analytics, Semrush, and Ahrefs. This experience in assessing content effectiveness and providing insights for continuous improvement directly translates to optimizing social media campaigns. My technical background, including a strong grasp of SEO and web development, provides a unique foundation for understanding digital platforms and staying ahead of emerging trends, ensuring Delvaux’s strategies remain current and impactful.

I am adept at managing projects autonomously, working remotely and collaboratively with teams to deliver comprehensive digital solutions. My detail-oriented nature is evident in my meticulous approach to technical SEO audits and structured data implementation, which would be applied to curating precise and effective social-first content. My fluency in English will facilitate seamless communication across all initiatives.

I am confident that my blend of content expertise, strategic thinking, and technical understanding aligns perfectly with Delvaux’s vision for this role. I am eager to apply my skills to lead and enhance Delvaux’s digital narrative.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- Led SEO content and website content management for client websites, utilizing WordPress and Canva for visually consistent digital presence.

- Managed multiple client projects, including building and optimizing complex websites, demonstrating strong project management and organizational skills.
- Fluent in English with a technical background in web development and AI, enhancing digital strategy and trend analysis.
